testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create a metric sheet-metal part ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And its Metric catalog contains the native standard part, assembly, drawing, sheet-metal and presentation templates ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects the metric template folder ✔ And the user selects the metric sheet-metal part template ✔ Then the template details identify a part with millimeter units ✔ When the user chooses Create ✔ Then a new part document becomes active ✔ And its viewport contains no visible model geometry ✔ And the browser shows a folded model and its origin ✔ And the sheet-metal ribbon is active ✔ And a new document tab is visible
